blocks.title: Serverless architecture
blocks.text: Serverless architectures let developers build and run applications without managing servers: the cloud provider allocates resources automatically as needed, and developers pay only for the computing actually used.

AWS Lambda runs code without provisioning or managing servers, so developers focus on writing code. Serverless applications scale automatically with demand, so you use and pay only for what you need (Amazing Fact). Servers still exist; the provider manages them.
